notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Composite Golem tokens and/or target any other nonlegendary creatures you control.
